channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: ONU propõe a candidatos medidas contra desigualdades de gênero
item.description: UN Women launched 10 proposals for Brazilian candidates to combat gender inequalities, addressing politics, violence, and economy. The initiatives aim to ensure female representation and eliminate disparities such as the 21% wage gap and 1,571 femicides in 2025.

item.title: Luta contra o rebaixamento é destaque no sábado (19/9) de Brasileirão
item.description: The 28th round of the 2026 Brasileirão, played on Saturday (September 19), highlights the relegation battle, with seven of the ten teams in relegation zone positions. Key matches include Atlético-MG vs. Chapecoense, Mirassol vs. Botafogo, and Santos vs. Remo, all with direct implications for the table. Santos and Botafogo, with the same points, compete for a spot in the Libertadores, while Chapecoense fights to avoid the relegation zone.

item.title: PREPARE O CORAÇÃO ANTES DE CLICAR! #FlávioBolsonaro, #LuladaSilva, #Eleições2026
item.description: The content features a viral post referencing potential candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for the 2026 elections, but contains no substantive information about proposals or events. It appears to be a misleading or low-value post without meaningful political analysis.

item.title: VÍDEO: posso votar no segundo turno se faltei no primeiro?
item.description: If a voter misses the first round of the 2026 elections, they can still vote in the second round, as each round is treated as a new election by the electoral court. However, the absence must be justified within 60 days, either through the e-Título app, the TSE's self-service portal, or by visiting a local electoral office with supporting documents.

item.title: Salário mínimo e aposentadoria: confira quais são as propostas dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: The 2026 presidential candidates' proposals on minimum wage and Social Security reflect divergences regarding benefit indexing. While Lula (PT) advocates maintaining real wage increases, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) proposes digitalization and professional management without union interference, without detailing changes to indexing. The debate includes the possibility of unlinking benefits from the minimum wage, directly impacting the population's purchasing power.

item.title: Governadores pedem a Lula inclusão do gás natural no Redata
item.description: The governors of Sergipe and Amazonas asked President Lula to include natural gas as an eligible energy source for data centers under Redata, highlighting local infrastructure and risk of lost investments. The federal government has not yet defined eligible energy sources.

item.title: Lula prepara caminhada com João Campos no Recife na 6ª feira
item.description: President Lula will visit Recife on Friday to walk with João Campos, the PSB candidate for Pernambuco governor. After repeated requests, the move undermines Raquel Lyra's strategy, which sought Rui Costa's support to block the rally. An AtlasIntel poll shows a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Governo Lula manobrou no STF para blindar aumento do Bolsa Família, diz advogada de Flávio
item.description: The Lula government implemented a 15% increase in Bolsa Família, which was challenged by Renan Santos at the TSE. Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes ruled that the raise merely adjusts values due to inflation, protecting the government from adverse rulings. The lawyer for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign accuses the government of an irregular maneuver combined with the Public Defender's Office.

item.title: Debate esvaziado reúne Zema, Cury e Samara em São Paulo
item.description: The presidential debate organized by Metrópoles, Inteligência Ltda., and G4 in São Paulo was hollowed out due to the absence of leading candidates, leaving only Romeu Zema, Augusto Cury, and Samara Martins. The three addressed topics such as economy, education, and criticism of the STF, with proposals ranging from privatizations to political system reforms.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa Comissão de Segurança como vitrine eleitoral, mas faltou a 72% das sessões
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro uses the Public Security Committee, which he chairs in the Senate, as an electoral platform, featuring it in advertisements broadcast on TV and radio. However, he missed 72% of the committee's sessions. His presence at the August session was an exception, occurring amid presidential campaign commitments.

item.title: Ministro defende que Lula divulgue carta com compromisso fiscal para novo mandato
item.description: Minister José Guimarães suggested that President Lula release a letter with fiscal commitments for a potential new term, emphasizing the need for strict economic measures in the 2026 campaign.

item.title: Samara diz que “absurdo” é o “bolsa-banqueiro”, não o Bolsa Família
item.description: Samara Martins claimed the biggest fiscal absurdity is public debt interest (R$1.8 trillion), not the Bolsa Família increase. She criticized the 6x1 work schedule and supported job creation, education, health, and renationalization of privatized companies.

item.title: Zema cita caso BRB-Master para defender privatizações de bancos
item.description: In a presidential debate, Romeu Zema (Novo) referenced the BRB and Banco Master case to criticize public institutions and advocate for the privatization of state-owned banks, linking the bank’s involvement to political interference.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mede a disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Nordeste
item.description: A new Quaest poll (BR-03961/2026), commissioned by TV Bahia, measures the 2026 electoral race in Bahia, including presidential (Lula vs. Flávio) and gubernatorial (ACM Neto vs. Jerônimo Rodrigues) scenarios. The survey, with 900 interviews and a 3-point margin of error, assesses voting intentions, approval of Lula’s government, and electoral emotions.

item.title: Cury e Zema trocam elogios, atacam STF e confrontam Samara em debate em SP
item.description: In a debate in São Paulo, presidential candidates Romeu Zema and Augusto Cury avoided direct confrontations, exchanged compliments, and united in criticism of the STF. The two focused their attacks on Samara Martins, the only woman in the race. The debate, organized by Metrópoles and Inteligência Ltda., was considered hollow due to the lack of confrontation among candidates.

item.title: Cury diz que Lula usa “a dor dos outros” com reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) criticized the Bolsa Família adjustment announced by Lula near the elections, accusing the government of using the pain of recipients to gain votes. During a debate hosted by Metrópoles, Cury emphasized the importance of the increase but questioned its timing, suggesting beneficiaries deserved more than R$ 900. He also referenced a visit to Rocinha to listen to residents and criticized Lula for exploiting people's vulnerability in his campaign.

item.title: Em debate, Cury cobra Fachin por apuração do caso Master: “Doa a quem doer”
item.description: Augusto Cury urged STF president Edson Fachin to advance investigations into the Banco Master case during a debate hosted by Inteligência Ltda and Metrópoles. He proposed judicial reform with an eight-year term limit for Supreme Court justices and criticized the Senate over alleged ties to individuals connected to the case. Cury labeled the related expenditures as 'dishonest money'.

item.title: Zema no debate Metrópoles/Inteligência Ltda: “Quero o Brasil fora do Brics”
item.description: Romeu Zema proposed Brazil's withdrawal from BRICS, criticizing dependence on China and advocating greater integration with Mercosul. He noted that China accounts for over 30% of Brazil's trade and called the group a 'patchwork quilt'.

item.title: Aliada de Lula, Leila defende impeachment de Moraes em propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Senator Leila do Vôlei (PDT), an ally of Lula, publicly supported the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for the first time during an electoral broadcast. She emphasized the need for investigations into alleged connections between Moraes, Daniel Vorcaro, and Banco Master.

item.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (18) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Friday (18), presidential candidates held debates, interviews, and social events. Lula emphasized anti-addiction efforts and social policies, while others addressed entrepreneurship, labor mobilization, and community projects.

item.title: Tarcísio aponta motivação eleitoral em reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: The governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), stated that the Bolsa Família adjustment announced by President Lula (PT) has electoral motivation. He agreed with Flávio Bolsonaro's statement calling the measure an 'act of desperation' from the PT campaign.

item.title: Votar em mulheres de direita não dá certo, diz Lula
item.description: Lula stated that women should vote for left-wing candidates, citing Marina Silva and Simone Tebet as examples, during a campaign event in Guarulhos. He repudiated violence against women and emphasized the importance of women holding their heads high. The event featured Janja Lula, Geraldo Alckmin, and Fernando Haddad.

item.title: Lula diz que vai “acabar com a pouca vergonha no futebol”
item.description: President Lula reiterated at a rally in Guarulhos his intention to end 'betting markets' in football, responding to clubs opposing online betting regulations; he stated the government does not fear losing tax revenue, citing R$ 62 billion collected.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: a nova pesquisa Datafolha sobre a corrida presidencial
item.description: A new Datafolha poll commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo and Globo investigates voting intention for the 2026 presidential race with thirteen candidates, including Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey also analyzes candidate rejection rates, voting decision patterns, government evaluation, and the activity of the Supreme Court (STF). Data collection will take place from September 22 to 24 with 2,002 interviews and a two-point percentage margin of error.

item.title: Quem são e quanto ganham aliados de Paes na prefeitura do Rio
item.description: During Eduardo Paes' (PSD) term in the Rio city hall from 2021 to 2026, over 8,900 appointed positions were filled, many with political ties, costing R$ 404 million. Allies such as Dalila de Brito Ferreira (União Brasil) and Elias Jabbour (PCdoB) topped the earnings, with gross salaries exceeding the constitutional ceiling, though deductions lowered net pay.

item.title: Presidente do PT proíbe divulgação de materiais de campanha sem número de Lula
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of PT, instructed that candidates who omit Lula in campaign materials should be punished, including returning electoral funds.

item.title: Cury e Zema focam debate em críticas ao STF e a reajuste do Bolsa Família às vésperas da eleição
item.description: In a debate hosted by Metrópoles, Inteligência Ltda and G4, candidates Romeu Zema, Augusto Cury and Samara Martins focused on criticizing the Supreme Court, the Bolsa Família adjustment and the poll leaders Lula and Bolsonaro. Zema and Cury accused the Supreme Court of corruption and advocated for reforms in the judiciary, while highlighting irregularities in re-election and Lula's demagoguery.

item.title: Lula diz que fez “vaquinha” de R$ 24.000 para apostador viciado
item.description: President Lula claimed during a campaign event in Guarulhos that he once raised 24,000 BRL through a crowdfunding effort to help a gambling addict, using the story to denounce betting companies and vow to shut them down in order to curb money laundering and protect low-income families.

item.title: Paes justifica ausência em agenda de Lula: “É proibido pela lei”
item.description: Eduardo Paes, a PSD candidate for Rio de Janeiro governor, justified his absence from events with President Lula by claiming that the law prohibits candidates from participating in official government activities. He emphasized respect for electoral legislation and reaffirmed his support for the PT candidate.

item.title: Ato falho: Marina troca próprio número pelo de Salles durante ato de Lula
item.description: Marina Silva made campaign errors at Lula's event in Guarulhos, mixing her own ballot number (180) with Ricardo Salles' (300) and mistakenly claiming gubernatorial candidacy. Simone Tebet corrected her, and the event included Lula, Haddad, and other allies.

item.title: Lula diz que seleção e clubes foram campeões mundiais sem bets
item.description: President Lula stated at an event in Guarulhos that Brazilian clubs and the national team won world titles without the support of betting houses, criticizing the legalization of sports betting in 2018 and announcing plans to ban betting platforms. He cited São Paulo, Santos, Grêmio, Flamengo, Internacional, and Corinthians as examples, while Brazilian clubs released a manifesto opposing potential restrictions on sports betting. A survey shows 88% of online users criticize the clubs' stance, and a ban could be announced before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que não fazia consulta a partidos para nomear cargos e cita 'distância da política' ao comentar relação com Milton Leite
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated his administration does not consult political parties for appointments, prioritizing technical criteria and maintaining distance from politics. He emphasized his relationship with Milton Leite is institutional, limited to infrastructure and sanitation matters.

item.title: Fifa divulga adversários do Brasil na inédita Copa do Mundo Sub-15; veja tabela
item.description: FIFA set the groups for the first Under-15 World Cup, with Brazil in Group D facing DR Congo, El Salvador, Guinea-Bissau, Nepal and Tunisia. The tournament, held in Azerbaijan, features 191 teams and uses an innovative six-level performance format.

item.title: A nova derrota unânime de Eduardo Bolsonaro em Turma do STF
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF unanimously rejected Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal against his four-year-two-month prison sentence for coercion in the 'tariff' case, viewed as an attempt to influence Jair Bolsonaro's trial in the coup plot. Votes were cast by justices Flávio Dino, Cristiano Zanin, Cármen Lúcia, and Alexandre de Moraes, concluding the virtual hearing started the previous week. Since 2023, Eduardo Bolsonaro has lived in the United States and lost his parliamentary seat due to absences from Chamber sessions.

item.title: Lula cita Flamengo e Corinthians e diz estar decidido a 'acabar com bets'
item.description: At a rally in Guarulhos, Lula (PT) criticized betting houses and mentioned Flamengo and Corinthians, reinforcing his stance against 'bets' following a club manifesto. He took a firm tone to appeal to voters concerned about the rise of illegal gambling.

item.title: Em comício, Tebet acena a mulheres, ataca Derrite e associa Flávio a Master
item.description: Simone Tebet spoke at a campaign rally in Guarulhos alongside Lula, attacking political opponents and linking adversaries to controversial figures. She also criticized the previous government and emphasized women's participation in politics.

item.title: Haddad ao eleitorado paulistano: Realizem o sonho do Tarcísio que é ir embora de SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, said at a rally in Guarulhos that voters should fulfill Tarcísio de Freitas's wish of leaving the state. The remark was an indirect reference to the governor, who is seeking reelection under the Republicanos party. Haddad emphasized the importance of popular participation to change the direction of the state government.

item.title: Anúncio de reajuste do Bolsa Família gera desinformação nas redes sociais
item.description: President Lula announced a 15% adjustment to the Bolsa Família program, sparking political reactions and a wave of misinformation on social media. The measure, released 17 days before the first round of elections, became the target of fact-checks due to misleading content. The announcement reinforces the social agenda of the reelection candidate.

item.title: 1ª Turma do STF tem maioria para manter condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro em caso de coação
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF upheld the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion, related to actions of influence over the Brazilian Judiciary during his stay in the United States.

item.title: "Quem legalizou o Master foi o Bolsonaro", diz Lula em ato de campanha
item.description: Lula attributed the Master Bank scandal to the previous Bolsonaro administration, highlighting that Vorcaro was arrested during his tenure. The re-election candidate also distanced himself from the INSS scheme, accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of ties to the 'Careca'. Alckmin and Tebet reinforced the accusations as the 2026 election debate intensified with a focus on corruption.

item.title: Tebet diz que Flávio não pode ir às urnas sem explicar Master
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) must clarify his ties to the Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro before the elections. Speaking in Guarulhos (SP), she praised Lula's policies such as raising the minimum wage and tax exemptions on essential goods.

item.title: Tarcísio deixou SP “de pires na mão” e é ingrato com Lula, diz Haddad
item.description: Haddad criticized Tarcísio for leaving São Paulo 'in disarray' and called him ungrateful to Lula, highlighting federal support for the state. He emphasized federal actions such as increased BNDES funding and debt renegotiation, demanding transparency from the governor.

item.title: STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo por coação
item.description: The First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) unanimously rejected the appeal filed by the defense of Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) and upheld his conviction to four years and two months in prison for coercion. The ruling was issued on Friday, the 18th, concluding the hearing on the objections of notice. The case refers to a criminal action involving coercion during the proceedings.

item.title: “Decidi que vou acabar com as bets”, diz Lula
item.description: At a campaign rally in Guarulhos, Lula pledged to shut down sports betting companies to fight money laundering and household debt, reinforcing his anti-bets rhetoric.

item.title: 1ª Turma mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por obstrução
item.description: The STF's First Chamber upheld Eduardo Bolsonaro's 4-year and 2-month sentence for obstruction of justice, rejecting the DPU's appeal to reduce the penalty. Minister Alexandre de Moraes emphasized that the former federal deputy's statements do not constitute spontaneous confession, making the mitigating factor inadmissible. The ruling addressed declaration objections, with votes acknowledging a confession but understanding the sentence already accounted for it.

item.title: 'O estado saiu do vermelho', diz o governador em exercício, Ricardo Couto, durante evento no Rio com presidente Lula
item.description: Interim governor Ricardo Couto said at an event with President Lula that Rio de Janeiro state has moved out of fiscal deficit and reached a budget surplus, reversing a projected deficit of 18.9 billion reais. He highlighted cost-cutting measures such as the elimination of vacant executive positions.

item.title: Por unanimidade, STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: The STF rejected by majority Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal, upholding his four-year-two-month prison sentence for coercion during proceedings, for orchestrating tariffs against Brazilian exports to protect his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Primeira Turma do STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação
item.description: The First Panel of the STF unanimously upheld the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro to four years and two months in prison for coercion, rejecting the appeal filed by the Defender of the Union. The former federal deputy was convicted for attempting to interfere in the trial of the coup plot case involving his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Currently abroad since February 2025, Eduardo had his term revoked for abandoning his duties in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a deputado federal por Sergipe (SE) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, over 1.7 million eligible voters in Sergipe will choose 8 federal deputies for the Chamber of Deputies in a single-round vote on October 4th. The election uses a proportional system, where votes are summed by party or federation to determine seat allocation. Among the 141 candidates are Acácio Cardoso (PSDB Cidadania), Alberto Macedo (Republicanos), Alessandra da ONG (Agir Pára o Avanço), Alex Pintado (União Brasil), Allan Marques (Novo) and Amanda Oliveira (Brasil da Esperança).

item.title: Desconfiança no STF bate recorde no Datafolha, e metade dos eleitores diz que crise influenciará voto para presidente
item.description: Datafolha survey records peak distrust in the STF (48%) and shows 47% of voters say institutional crisis will influence their presidential vote, with Lula (38%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (31%) cited as most affected.
